composition.encoding: round5_cegar_v29.Encoding with schema_v29 full nonapex physical K4-shell semantics
composition.engine: round5_cegar_v19 Boolean-master, fixed-assignment QF_LRA replay, v18 static equality bank, and hash-chained journal

runtime_binding.v12: bound through round5_cegar_v29._bound_v12_runtime, then rebased to the v30 frozen provenance
runtime_binding.v16: Encoding, schema paths, provenance, and source contract are temporarily rebound to v30
runtime_binding.v19: schema paths, provenance, source contract, and frozen-provenance verifier are temporarily rebound to v30
runtime_binding.restoration: every mutable module global is restored in a finally block, including exceptional exits

fixed_assignment_replay.assignment: all profile-specific semantic Boolean variables, authenticated by exact fix-name set equality against the frozen full formula
fixed_assignment_replay.primary: v19 audited exact PB rewrite and QF_LRA check
fixed_assignment_replay.independent_replay: v19 fresh-context reconstruction and repeated QF_LRA check
fixed_assignment_replay.blocker_admission: only dual-UNSAT replay with matching compositional identity
fixed_assignment_replay.journal: v19 immutable fsynced hash chain, renamed as a v30 artifact

raw_probe.unsat_admission: raw primary UNSAT plus fresh frozen-formula UNSAT replay
raw_probe.fallback: raw SAT, UNKNOWN, or error falls through to unchanged v19 primary plus fresh-context normalized QF_LRA replay
raw_probe.journal: the v19 journal records the proposed assignment and the authenticated final outcome, including raw-probe metadata

spawn_contract.stable_seed: SHA-256(base seed, NUL, case id), low 31 bits
spawn_contract.child_attestation: exact v30 provenance, v29 encoding identity, v19 engine identity, PID, and spawn method
spawn_contract.parent_gate: case identity, full provenance, exact profile-specific Boolean count, constraint counts 465 and 4368, journal summary, power-row accounting, terminal policy, and durable result bytes

artifact_contract.result_hash: summary.json records result_file_sha256_by_case; result.json never embeds its own digest

retry_source.subset_selection: optional exact filter by the profile-specific frozen semantic Boolean count; the selected case ids remain sorted and are drawn only from the authenticated v29 UNKNOWN universe

terminal_status.unknown_policy: no new blocker is admitted without replay-authenticated UNSAT
terminal_status.process_exit: nonzero unless every requested case is complete

trust_boundary: external exact-n15 Z3 evidence; not a Lean theorem, kernel certificate, or universal closure result
